new_entrant_score.label: New-entrant path to paid driverless service (0 slow, 1 moderate, 2 fast)

vintages.nhtsa: NHTSA SGO ADS reports, 24 months ending Sep 2026
vintages.demand: Chicago TNP and NYC HVFHV calendar 2025

capture_share.label: Robotaxi share of ride-hail trips in the principal city
capture_share.rationale: Early-stage share for one operator in a mature market; one to eight percent spans a slow ramp to a strong ramp.

avg_fare_usd.label: Average fare per trip
avg_fare_usd.rationale: Priced near typical urban ride-hail fares; robotaxi premiums and discounts both appear in the market.

trips_per_vehicle_per_day.label: Paid trips per vehicle per day
trips_per_vehicle_per_day.rationale: Utilization of a driverless fleet in a mature geofence; depends on fleet size, geofence and hours of service.

avg_trip_miles.label: Paid miles per trip
avg_trip_miles.rationale: Typical urban ride-hail trip length; longer trips raise revenue per trip but also cost.

deadhead_share.label: Share of vehicle miles driven empty
deadhead_share.rationale: Empty repositioning and depot runs; lower with denser demand and good dispatch. Total miles = paid miles / (1 - deadhead).

cost_per_mile_usd.label: Non-energy operating cost per vehicle mile
cost_per_mile_usd.rationale: Maintenance, cleaning, insurance, remote assistance, depot and platform fees per mile. Excludes vehicle depreciation and charging.

kwh_per_mile.label: Energy use
kwh_per_mile.rationale: Electric SUV-class vehicle with sensor load in urban driving. Charging cost = kWh per mile x state commercial price.

vehicle_cost_usd.label: Vehicle cost, fully equipped
vehicle_cost_usd.rationale: Vehicle plus sensor and compute suite; falls with scale. Payback is measured against this number.

Chicago.source: Chicago Transportation Network Providers trips (data.cityofchicago.org, dataset 6dvr-xwnh), SoQL count

New York.source: NYC TLC High Volume FHV trip records, monthly row counts from parquet footers

demand_method.note: Estimate from two anchors scaled by a demand index; not a forecast.
